verdict.rationale: Qodo documents managing configuration as code with a .pr_agent.toml file at the repository, project, group, or organization level, which covers the versioned in-repo config core of the story. Ready-made presets (Minimal, Standard, Comprehensive, Custom) loosely resemble review profiles, but they apply to Display options and nothing ties them to the config file. Missing for 10: documented path filters, per-path review instructions, review profiles definable in the repo file, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
